newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain private consumption won't rise - Caja Cataluna.
newsitem.headline: Spain private consumption won't rise - Caja Cataluna.

text.p: Spanish private consumption will not pick up in 1997, despite a rise of 2.1 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996, Caja de Cataluna said in a research note.
Private consumption will also show a slight rise to 2.2 percent in the first quarter of 1997, but this will not last. In September, it sees private consumption expanding 2.1 to 2.2 percent.

"In this way, maximum consumption of this final expansion phase will have been registered in the months of December and January, producing later a reduction in its advance," according to Caja de Cataluna. --Madrid Newsroom +34 1 585 2167
